senses.gloss: m., constr. דַּם (b. h.; דום or דמם, cmp. דבב) liquid; blood; life.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 44a">Men. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>בדָמוֹ</he> (not <he>בדמה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) with the juice of the purple shell.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 31b:10">Sabb. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>רביעית ד׳ וכ׳</he> one fourth of a Log of blood did I (the Lord) put in your body (the smallest quantity required to sustain life, v.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 72b:15">Snh. 72ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 9:6">Gen. IX, 6</cite>) <he>הצל דָּמוֹ וכ׳</he> save the life of the one (who is pursued) at the expense of the life of the other (the pursuer).—<he>דַּם ברית</he> = <he>ד׳ של מילה</he> the blood lost at circumcision.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:9">Tosef. Sabb. XV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:9">XVI</cite>), 9 <he>צריך להטיף … ד׳ ב׳</he> he must cause the blood of the covenant to flow from him (even if born without preputium).
Pes. 16ᵇ ד׳ שהנפש וכ׳ the blood with which life escapes when cutting the animal’s throat is called a fluid (with regard to levitical purity, v. כָּשַׁר); a. v. fr.—Pl. דָּמִים.
Keth. 9ᵇ טענת ד׳ complaint of absence of the token of virginity.—שְׁפִיכוּת ד׳ (abbr. ש״ד) murder.
<cite ref="Mishnah Middot 3:1">Midd. III, 1</cite>, a. e. <he>ד׳ העליונים</he> blood sprinkled against the upper part of the altar, opp. <he>ד׳ התחתונים</he>.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 8:6">Snh. VIII, 6</cite>, a. fr. (with ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 22:1">Ex. XXII, 1</cite>) <he>יש לו ד׳</he> his blood is revenged, <he>אין לו ד׳</he> may be killed with impunity. Ib. 72ᵃ <he>בד׳ קננהו</he> he acquired possession of them by risking his life.—[<cite ref="D00897"><he>דָּמִים</he></cite> equivalent, v. <cite ref="D00897"><he>דָּמִים</he></cite>.)
